sitting-at-the-picnic.text: The capybara uses its nose to roll an orange towards you.

performing-the-jig-emote-at-the-picnic-0.text: The capybara and hippo don't seem to care for your moves.

performing-the-jig-emote-at-the-picnic-1.text: The hippo seems to find your moves interesting, but isn't totally sold on them. The capybara doesn't seem to care.

performing-the-jig-emote-at-the-picnic-2.text: The hippo seems to like your moves, but the capybara isn't convinced.

performing-the-jig-emote-at-the-picnic-3.text: The hippo seems to really enjoy your moves, but while the capybara likes them, it doesn't appear to quite love them.

performing-the-jig-emote-at-the-picnic-4.text: If you do not have a purple token in your inventory:

steps.text: The capybara and hippo both seem very impressed by your moves. The capybara uses its nose to roll a token towards you.

performing-the-jig-emote-at-the-picnic-4.text: If you have a purple token in your inventory:

steps.text: The capybara and hippo both seem very impressed by your moves.
